baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "laysa عليكم junahun an tadkhulu" negates liability for entering a specifically qualified class of houses.
baseline_models.mechanism: Negated blame releases literal ingress only where "houses" are excluded from residential inhabitation and contain usable provision or equipment for the entrants. The exception is therefore delimited by both place-type and benefit, rather than being a general license over empty property.

activation_trace.role: Supplies guilt or constriction, whose negation marks a bounded legal release.
Supplies literal passage into an interior as the released act.
Supplies the shelter or built interior that receives the entrant.
Supplies exclusion and difference, carving out a distinct house-class.
Supplies residential settlement, which the negated participle removes from the class.
Supplies useful goods or means for a need, making the entry purpose-bearing.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely excuses stepping into an empty building.
changed_reading.after: The ayah defines a purpose-limited entry exemption for a nonresidential place containing a recognized means of benefit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The phrase "buyutan ghayra maskunatin" joins house-form to the absence of resident inhabitation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The house branch can denote both structure and household, while the dwelling root can denote the resident people. Their negation allows a place to remain a functioning "house" without being someone's domestic interior. "Mata" then prevents "uninhabited" from collapsing into abandoned or useless.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the resident household as distinct from the bare structure.
Supplies the exclusion that detaches this house from the residential class.
Supplies the people of a dwelling, whose absence lowers the domestic privacy claim.
Supplies retained utility, showing that noninhabitation is not dereliction.

changed_reading.before: "Uninhabited houses" means abandoned or physically vacant shells.
changed_reading.after: It can mean functioning non-domestic premises: built interiors without a resident household, yet holding something legitimately useful to the entrant.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Physical "entry" is closed by the antithesis "what you make manifest and what you conceal" under divine knowledge.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah grants an outward act under objective qualifications, then places both displayed and withheld purpose within knowledge. The interior branch of entry makes the spatial threshold echo an inward threshold: accessibility of the place does not make the entrant's motive morally opaque.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an inner side or secret interior, linking spatial entry to inward purpose.
Supplies complete cognitive disclosure to the knower as the accountability frame.
Supplies emergence from concealment as the public side of conduct.
Supplies held-back secrecy as the inward side still encompassed by knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Once the building qualifies, the permission is exhausted by its outward physical conditions.
changed_reading.after: The place may be outwardly accessible, but the permission remains morally purpose-sensitive because displayed and concealed motives are equally known.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence forbids entry into others' houses until recognition and greeting, and even finding nobody does not itself permit entry: authorization must arrive or the visitor must return. Against that sequence, 24:29 does not equate vacancy with availability; it changes the category from a privacy-bearing resident household to a nonresidential, use-bearing premises.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the resident people whose absence defines the focus exception.
Supplies the recognized practical use that positively qualifies the exception.
Supplies the same literal ingress under a prohibition in the household case.
Supplies houses as households belonging to persons, the privacy-bearing contrast class.
Supplies perceptive recognition before crossing the household threshold.
Supplies an overt safety-making greeting as part of legitimate approach.
Supplies the belonging group whose domestic interior carries the claim.
Supplies explicit authorization, showing that absence of a found person is insufficient.
Supplies withdrawal to the prior position when access is refused.

structural_cues: 24:27-29 forms an immediate prohibition, no-person case, and qualified exception sequence.
The repeated entry and house lexemes hold the act constant while household presence, permission, and utility change.
The doubled return command in 24:28 makes refusal operational rather than merely advisory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies household recognition, greeting, no-person nonpermission, commanded retreat, and then the noninhabited-use exception; I infer a category boundary keyed to resident privacy and recognized use. A live alternative is three adjacent rules without a single underlying taxonomy.

changed_reading.before: A house becomes freely enterable whenever no person is presently found inside.
changed_reading.after: Temporary absence does not authorize entry; the exemption concerns a different, nonresidential use-class rather than an unattended private home.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verses immediately after the focus regulate what an entrant or passerby may look at and what another person may disclose. Lowered sight, guarded openings, apparent adornment, and concealed adornment turn the focus pair "reveal/conceal" into a reciprocal visibility regime. Permission to cross a low-privacy architectural threshold therefore does not grant unrestricted visual access.

activation_trace.role: Supplies manifest emergence as one pole of the focus accountability pair.
Supplies deliberate withholding as the other pole of the focus accountability pair.
Supplies active reduction and restraint, making the observer limit visual intake.
Supplies bodily seeing as conduct still governed after the entry rule.
Supplies protection of inviolability and chastity as a maintained boundary.
Supplies exposure of what should remain covered, identifying the privacy at stake.
Supplies controlled manifestation by the person whose adornment may appear.
Supplies what emerges into visibility, distinguishing appearance from total accessibility.
Supplies concealed adornment, sharpening the focus's hidden side into embodied privacy.

structural_cues: 24:30-31 follows the entry exception immediately and shifts from door control to eye and body control.
24:31 repeats the focus root of manifestation and pairs visible appearance with concealment.
Divine knowledge closes 24:29 while divine expertise closes 24:30, preserving an accountability frame across the shift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency, eye-restraint, guarded exposure, and a reveal/conceal lexical echo; I infer that permitted presence leaves visual duties intact. The live alternative is that the gaze rules are adjacent but legally independent.

changed_reading.before: Authorization to enter a nonresidential place settles the privacy question for that space.
changed_reading.after: Entry permission lowers one barrier only; observers must still limit sight, and persons retain control over bodily manifestation and concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later houses are described through authorization, elevation, repeated voiced remembrance, and a juxtaposition with trade and sale. This makes "house" a container whose social identity can come from sanctioned activity rather than sleeping residents. It strengthens reading the focus premises positively as a legible use-class, not merely negatively as somewhere empty.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the practical goods or means that define the focus premises by use.
Supplies built houses as containers for an authorized recurring function.
Supplies authorization as what legitimates the house's designated activity.
Supplies elevation of the place, marking it for a recognized function.
Supplies voiced remembrance as the recurring activity housed there.
Supplies profit-seeking commerce as a competing organized use-domain.
Supplies exchange by sale, concretizing non-domestic functional traffic.

structural_cues: 24:36 begins locatively with houses and defines them by authorized repeated acts.
24:37 immediately contrasts that activity with trade and sale, placing ritual and commercial functions in one spatial horizon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies houses authorized for recurring activity and an immediate commerce contrast; I infer that houses can be classified by socially legible function. A live alternative is that these later houses form a sacred scene with no taxonomic bearing on 24:29.

changed_reading.before: "Noninhabited" is only a negative description of what the premises lack.
changed_reading.after: The premises can be a positive functional class whose authorized use, rather than residence, explains both access and the benefit found there.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later permission rule identifies exposed times, requires authorization then, repeats the focus no-blame formula afterward, and explains the relaxation through habitual circulation. Privacy is thus a variable load generated by exposure and traffic, not a permanent property of walls. The focus's habitation-and-utility test becomes one instance of that broader calibration.

activation_trace.role: Supplies resident presence as the focus variable that raises or lowers domestic privacy.
Supplies beneficial use as the counterweight supporting access.
Supplies required authorization at heightened-private intervals.
Supplies time as a variable that changes the privacy status of the same household.
Supplies covered vulnerability, explaining why selected times demand a barrier.
Supplies the same categorical negation used to release liability in the focus.
Supplies the same blame category, relaxed after the exposed intervals.
Supplies repeated circulation around others as the practical reason for relaxed access.

structural_cues: 24:58 repeats the focus formula "laysa عليكم ... junahun" while explicitly dividing before, during, and after.
Three exposure intervals contrast with habitual circulation after them.
The same people and house can move between higher and lower permission requirements without any architectural change.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies timed exposure, authorization, the repeated no-blame formula, and circulation; I infer a common balancing mechanism between privacy load and necessary movement. The live alternative is separate case-specific exemptions linked only rhetorically.

changed_reading.before: Residential status alone determines how much permission a threshold requires.
changed_reading.after: The surah calibrates access by a changing combination of occupancy, exposure time, habitual circulation, and useful purpose; 24:29 is the nonresidential case of that matrix.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later house catalogue links consumption to one's own and relatives' houses, control of keys, friendship, a repeated release from blame, and greeting on entry. These branches turn "benefit for you" from subjective desire into a socially recognizable access relation: provision, kinship, stewardship, or trusted companionship can connect person, place, and use.

activation_trace.role: Supplies useful provision or equipment as the focus ground for entry.
Supplies an allotted edible provision, giving concrete content to legitimate benefit.
Supplies a network of households whose relationships structure access.
Supplies possessed authority of disposal as one recognizable access basis.
Supplies the key as an instrument of access, converting trust or stewardship into capability.
Supplies true companionship as a non-kin relation supporting shared provision.
Supplies the repeated removal of blame around use of provision.
Supplies renewed literal entry, returning the relational catalogue to threshold conduct.
Supplies a safety-making greeting that keeps even entitled entry socially overt.

structural_cues: 24:61 enumerates houses by relationship and key control before repeating no blame.
The verse moves from eating entitlement to entry and greeting, joining benefit, access, and social acknowledgment.
The focus dative "for you" is echoed by a later detailed map of who may use provision where.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, household relations, key control, friendship, no blame, and greeting; I infer that focus utility denotes recognizable entitlement rather than any self-asserted advantage. A live alternative is that 24:61 specifies only food-sharing and should not narrow 24:29 generally.

changed_reading.before: Any personally desired advantage can count as "benefit for you" and justify entry.
changed_reading.after: The benefit is better read as a legible relation between entrant, premises, and use, analogous to provision, stewardship, kinship, or trusted access.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a physical entry rule into the informational domain. It remains anchored in the focus branches for household, inner secret, manifestation, and concealment, while the context supplies speech received and spread. Render it only as an ethical analogy generated by the wording, not as a claim that the legal referent of "houses" is rumor.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus links entry into houses with an inner side and closes on the movement between concealment and manifestation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies access to an inner or secret side as the analogy's threshold.
Supplies the household whose inward affairs can be crossed informationally.
Supplies emergence into publicity as the outbound movement.
Supplies a held-back household matter as what should not be extracted without warrant.
Supplies speech taken up and passed onward, modeling informational transit.
Supplies the tongue as the carrier that moves material out of an inward domain.
Supplies opening the mouth in speech as the point of outward release.
Supplies diffusion among people as the public destination of extracted material.

changed_reading.before: The ayah's threshold ethics concerns only bodies passing through doors.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also yields an analogy for informational trespass: practical access to a place or household does not license carrying its concealed interior into public circulation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the surface verb plainly denotes people entering, while the cited entry branch concerns incoming yield. It remains worth carrying because the same focus names useful goods in a nonresidential house and the later context names trade and sale. Render it as economic resonance supporting a premises-type, not as a replacement translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "Enter houses not inhabited in which there is mata for you" can resonate with premises through which useful goods, earnings, and users circulate.

activation_trace.role: Supplies incoming yield or revenue, adding an economic inflow resonance to bodily ingress.
Supplies the built container capable of serving as premises rather than a household.
Supplies absent residents, freeing the premises from a domestic identity.
Supplies goods, equipment, or provisions that move through a functional premises.
Supplies organized profit-seeking commerce as a whole-surah use-domain.
Supplies exchange by sale as a concrete form of non-domestic traffic.

changed_reading.before: The exception concerns generic empty shelters that happen to contain something useful.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it evokes nonresidential economic or logistical premises where people, goods, and benefit legitimately flow, while motive remains accountable.

strongest_changes: 24:27-28 blocks the inference that an unattended private house is automatically enterable and makes 24:29 a category exception.
24:30-31 extends threshold ethics into gaze and controlled visibility, so permitted entry does not erase privacy.
24:58 reframes privacy as time- and circulation-sensitive through the same no-blame formula.
24:61 makes utility relational through provision, households, keys, friendship, entry, and greeting.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet turned a short exception into a calibrated access system. Exact recurrences of entry, houses, no blame, permission, manifestation, concealment, and divine knowledge connected architecture, bodily visibility, time, circulation, useful provision, and accountable intent without collapsing them into one rule.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether "not inhabited" primarily means no resident household or also includes temporarily unused premises remains grammatically live, though 24:27-28 weighs against mere temporary absence.
The function-defined and economic readings may describe likely premises-types without exhausting the legal class.
The final knowledge clause may condition the exception through intent, or may append accountability without altering its outward validity.
The informational-threshold model is analogical and should not be presented as the verse's direct legal denotation.
